name: ReX-MLE
description: ReX-MLE is a benchmark consisting of 20 challenges derived from medical imaging competitions, designed to evaluate autonomous coding agents on end-to-end workflows including data preprocessing, model training, and submission under realistic constraints.
reputation: A niche benchmark for autonomous coding agents in medical-imaging competition workflows; interesting for end-to-end automation but not yet broadly adopted.
notes: Evaluates full end-to-end workflows for medical imaging tasks; highlights performance gaps between autonomous agents and human experts.
